name: integrix
description: Claude Code plugins for integration in JAX with integrix.

plugins.name: integrix
plugins.description: Use integrix's quadrature against a rule, running integrals, adaptive quadrature with an error estimate, expectations with a standard error, time steppers and checkpointed or truncated adjoints instead of hand-rolled trapz sums, scipy.integrate calls and time loops: two skills (quadrature and expectations, time stepping) and a reuse reviewer.
